note: Official statistical series retrieved on 25 November 2026 and copied here without change. Each block gives the source, the series identifiers and the definition as the source words it. Only the US price index, the Japanese series and the EU production series are specific to transformers; the others cover a wider group of electrical equipment.

germany_order_backlog.source: Statistisches Bundesamt (Destatis), GENESIS-Online, tables 42113-0001 and 42113-0002 (range of the order backlog) and 42155-0004 and 42155-0005 (order backlog, volume index)
germany_order_backlog.definition: Range of the order backlog in months: the order backlog divided by turnover, using a moving twelve-month average of the turnover of the branch. The backlog is the sum of orders received that have not yet led to turnover and have not been cancelled.

branches.WZ08-271: Electric motors, generators, transformers and switchgear

germany_order_backlog.coverage_note: The range starts in April 2015. The four-digit branch 27.11 starts in January 2019. The latest month, September 2026, is provisional. Nothing finer than branch 27.11 is published.

us_unfilled_orders.source: US Census Bureau, Manufacturers' Shipments, Inventories and Orders (M3), full dataset updated 3 November 2026

categories.35C: Electrical equipment manufacturing (NAICS 335311, 335312, 335313, 335314: transformers, motors and generators, switchgear, relays and controls)
categories.MTU: Manufacturing with unfilled orders: shipments of the industries that report unfilled orders, set against all unfilled orders

us_unfilled_orders.definition: Unfilled orders at the end of the period equal unfilled orders at the beginning, plus new orders net of cancellations, less net sales. Shipments are net selling values, f.o.b. plant.
us_unfilled_orders.unit: million US dollars, seasonally adjusted, monthly

us_producer_prices.source: US Bureau of Labor Statistics, Producer Price Index, not seasonally adjusted

series_titles.PCU335311335311: Electric power and specialty transformer manufacturing (industry index, base June 1981)
series_titles.WPU117409: Power and distribution transformers, except parts (commodity index, base December 1999)

us_producer_prices.coverage_note: The last four months are preliminary. No index for large power transformers or by size class is published. The product index inside the industry series was discontinued after February 2023.

japan.orders_source: Japan Electrical Manufacturers' Association, orders of made-to-order heavy electrical equipment by product, survey of 13 member companies
japan.orders_unit: million yen, excluding consumption tax, fiscal year from April
japan.production_source: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry, Current Survey of Production, as republished by the association
japan.production_unit: million yen, fiscal year from April
japan.large_units_label: Non-standard oil-immersed transformers of 100,000 kVA and above (production: units, total kVA and value)
japan.coverage_note: The published orders workbooks start in fiscal year 2020.

eu_production_large_transformers.source: Eurostat Prodcom, sold production, DS-059358 (2015 to 2024) and DS-059367 (2025), EU27
eu_production_large_transformers.label: Liquid dielectric transformers having a power handling capacity above 10,000 kVA
eu_production_large_transformers.coverage_note: Flag R marks a rounded value, with its rounding base. The unit counts for 2018 to 2020 are published with large rounding bases and are out of line with the other years. The 2025 value comes from a different dataset and list version.

eu_business_survey.source: European Commission, DG ECFIN, Business and Consumer Survey, industry sub-sector series, NACE 27 (electrical equipment), EU, not seasonally adjusted, quarterly
eu_business_survey.definition: Question 13: current level of capacity utilisation, per cent. Question 8: factors limiting production, per cent of firms naming each factor.

us_capacity.source: Federal Reserve Board, G.17 Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization, seasonally adjusted, monthly
us_capacity.coverage_note: Capacity utilisation is published for NAICS 335 (electrical equipment, appliances and components) and not for NAICS 3353 (electrical equipment).
